label: Bible Study
prompt: Then the LORD put forth his hand, and _____ my mouth. And the LORD said unto me, Behold, I have put my words in thy mouth.
verse: Then the LORD put forth his hand, and touched my mouth. And the LORD said unto me, Behold, I have put my words in thy mouth.
note: Young Jeremiah protested that he was just a child — so God touched his mouth and filled it.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy _____: this is the first commandment.
verse: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this is the first commandment.
note: Jesus calls this the first commandment: love God with everything — heart, soul, mind, and strength.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And they heard the voice of the LORD God walking in the garden in the _____ of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God amongst the trees of the garden.
verse: And they heard the voice of the LORD God walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God amongst the trees of the garden.
note: God came walking in the garden in the cool of the day — and for the first time, his people hid instead of meeting him.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And _____ not the holy Spirit of God, whereby ye are sealed unto the day of redemption.
verse: And grieve not the holy Spirit of God, whereby ye are sealed unto the day of redemption.
note: Only a person can be grieved — and the same Spirit is the seal that keeps you until redemption day.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: It is the spirit that _____; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.
verse: It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.
note: 'Quickeneth' means gives life. Moments later Peter answers: 'thou hast the words of eternal life' (verse 68).
